mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent.borehole (hole_id, area_id, x, y, z, total_depth, drill_purpose, drill_date, status) VALUES (#{holeId}, #{areaId}, #{x}, #{y}, #{z}, #{totalDepth}, #{drillPurpose}, #{drillDate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT hole_id, area_id, x, y, z, total_depth, drill_purpose, drill_date, status FROM agent.borehole WHERE hole_id = #{holeId}
SELECT hole_id, area_id, x, y, z, total_depth, drill_purpose, drill_date, status FROM agent.borehole
